services.name: General Admission
services.desc: Sudekum Planetarium is a state-of-the-art 63-foot dome theater with an unparalleled projection system. Our programs include planetarium shows, laser shows, and occasional featured events like concerts. Our accessibility offerings include open captions for most shows (except live shows and laser shows) and assistive listening devices. Just ask a team member as you enter the planetarium. Learn more about accessibility at Adventure Science Center. Sit back, relax, and watch the stars come out during Nightwatch, our live show that highlights the stars, constellations, and planets visible in the evening at this time of year. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Want to bring a field trip to the science center? We've got an array of STEM programming tailored specifically for schools. You'll find content and programs that align directly with the current Tennessee Science Grade Level Expectations. Explore our awesome exhibitions, then add on a planetarium show, science show, and hands-on lab. All our offerings are matched to Tennessee Science Grade Level Expectations. Our homeschool classes bring hands-on, minds-on explorations of subjects like chemistry, physics, meteorology, and more. Each lesson building on the foundation laid during the previous class. Don't settle for an ordinary venue. Choose Adventure Science Center, where inspiring spaces, interactive experiences, and exceptional service come together to create events your guests will be talking about long after they end.
